sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN num n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'CARDINAL HEALTH INC' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 4 AND n.uom = 'USD') * 1.0 / (((SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN num n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'CARDINAL HEALTH INC' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'InventoryNet' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 0 AND n.uom = 'USD') + (SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN num n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'CARDINAL HEALTH INC' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'InventoryNet' AND n.ddate = 20250630 AND n.qtrs = 0 AND n.uom = 'USD')) / 2.0), 4)
